diagnosis: The dominant currently demonstrated multiplicative bottleneck is not worker scarcity. It is burst pressure on append-only durable writes and premature frontier replenishment while a young cohort already owns work. Unrelated main-head movement can reject a legitimate deterministic CREATE; simultaneously, planners can add more writes before young pins have had one heartbeat target to produce returns/successors.
